game: World of Warcraft: Forever, level 60 Shaman (Dwarf)
primary_data: wowsims/forever @ 125e534 (2026-11-08), spell store regenerated from the live client (1.60.1.70862 and its hotfix cache); cross-checked against wowforevertalents.com tooltips (same build) and mythicsim-forever-engine @ b3c5eb6
value_conventions: mean_at_60 = BasePoints + PointsPerLevel*(min(60, MaxLevel) - BaseLevel). min/max = mean*(1 -/+ variance/2), rounded; the game applies the roll after adding bonus healing/damage. Coefficients are EffectBonusCoefficient (per tick for periodic effects).

Healing Wave.variance_rule: game rolls the whole amount incl. bonus: (mean + coef*bonus) * U(1-v/2, 1+v/2) (wowsims core/spell_result.go CalcDamage/CalcHealing)
Healing Wave.notes: Rank 9 is the highest trainer rank. Rank 10 (25357) is taught by the AQ20 book Tablet of Healing Wave X (data/repos/wowsims-forever/sim/core/spelldata/book_ranks.go:21; data/repos/mythicsim-forever-engine/src/prepare/spelldata/book_ranks.rs:52). Forever values are lower than Classic Era (Era R10 1620-1850).

Call of the Elements.notes: Summons the four pre-set totems; costs the sum of their mana. Call of the Spirits (66844, lvl 40 row) and Call of the Ancestors (66843, lvl 30 row) are the 2nd/3rd sets; the deep dive gives the opposite levels.

Totemic Call.notes: Renamed from Totemic Projection; moves your totems to you; 30 s cooldown; 25% of base mana.

base_stats_dwarf_shaman_60.status: mixed: base mana and race offsets forever-confirmed; class attributes/health from sim tables; base crit vanilla fallback
source: https://github.com/wowsims/forever PR #619 (Forever confirmed original race offsets, ClassicWoWCommunity/forever-bugs#414)
base_stats_dwarf_shaman_60.notes: Dwarf offsets Str +2, Agi -4, Sta +3, Int -1, Spi -1 on class base Str 85/Agi 55/Sta 95/Int 90/Spi 100. Base crit comes from hand-kept vanilla tables (tools/base_stats_parser.py).

health_per_stamina.value: first 20 Stamina give 1 HP each, every point above 20 gives 10 HP

mana_per_intellect.value: first 20 Int give 1 mana each, every point above 20 gives 15 mana (mana = base + 20 + 15*(Int-20))

melee_crit_per_agility_pct.notes: Dodge per Agility is the same 0.0508%.

base_spell_crit_pct.status: vanilla fallback (hand-kept table; no Forever game file ships it)

attack_power.value: AP = 100 + 2*Strength (Agility gives no AP to a Shaman); Mental Dexterity adds 50/100/150% of Int

ap_to_dps.formula: weapon damage + weapon_speed * AP / 14; specials use normalized speed (2.4 1H, 3.3 2H, 1.7 dagger)

combat_ratings_at_60.status: forever-confirmed (CombatRatings gametable from the Forever client)

hit_and_crit_merged.value: one Hit Rating feeds melee, ranged and spell hit; one Crit Rating feeds melee, ranged and spell crit. Agility still gives melee crit and Intellect spell crit separately.
hit_and_crit_merged.status: forever-confirmed (Blizzard) / sim model for the split
source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/news/24303313 ('Spell, melee, and ranged hit chance are combined')

bonus_healing_to_damage.value: Applied on items: a 'bonus healing' item row also states spell damage of about 1/3 of it, rounded (e.g. Benediction 195 healing / 65 damage). The sim keeps HealingPower and SpellDamage as two stats; heals use HealingPower x coefficient, damage spells use SpellDamage (+ school damage) x coefficient.
source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/news/24303313 ('Bonus healing now also includes one third as much bonus damage')
bonus_healing_to_damage.notes: A few items (e.g. Pure Elementium Band 19382, Rejuvenating Gem 19395) carry healing with no damage in the current data.

spirit_mana_regen.value: 6.25 + Spirit/8 mana per second (= 2.5*(12.5 + Spirit/4) per 5 s), for every class
source: https://github.com/wowsims/forever/pull/299 ('all mana classes were moved to the formula that was just for Mage/Priests')
spirit_mana_regen.disagreement: mythicsim (frozen Go reference) uses 7.5 + Spirit/10 per second for Shaman: data/repos/mythicsim-forever-engine/src/prepare/character.rs:518-522. Vanilla fallback for Shaman: 17 + Spirit/5 per 2 s tick (8.5 + Spirit/10 per second).

five_second_rule.value: Spirit regen stops for 5 s after any mana spend (or until a hard cast ends, whichever is later); MP5 continues. Mindfulness lets 50% continue while casting; Improved Stormstrike 50% for 15 s.
five_second_rule.status: sim model (vanilla rule retained; no Forever statement found)

mp5.value: MP5/5 mana per second, continuous, unaffected by the 5-second rule

regen_tick.value: about 2.02 s per-player tick in combat logs; wowsims credits regen continuously every 100 ms

crit_multipliers.notes: Elemental Fury 5/5: +100% crit bonus for Fire/Frost/Nature spells and fire totems (2.0x). Dwarf Earth Fury (2% crit damage) removed 26 Oct; Tauren 2% crit bonus removed.

spell_hit_table.status: vanilla fallback for the level table; 'no 1% floor' is a wowsims Forever rule without a cited source
source: wowsims commit 0301ba3421 'No 1% spell miss floor in Forever'

dwarf_racials.value: Artisan's Precision +1% hit with spells and attacks; Stoneform -10% physical damage taken 8 s, 3 min cd; Earth Fury removed
source: https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/wow-forever-beta-development-notes/2360696 (2 Nov 2026 notes, posted 3 Nov) (26 Oct racial post)

gcd.status: forever-confirmed (row GCDMs; Shaman deep dive 'All totems now have a 1.0 second global cooldown')
gcd.notes: wowsims lets spell haste shorten the GCD down to 1.0 s (sim model).

gaps: Healing Wave / Lesser Healing Wave / Chain Heal: no Blizzard note explains why Forever values are below Classic Era; the numbers are client data.
Riptide HoT tick crits: not stated anywhere checked.
Spirit regen formula: wowsims (6.25+Spi/8 per s, measured) and mythicsim (7.5+Spi/10 per s) disagree; no Blizzard statement.
Five-second rule and attack tables (glancing, crit suppression, DW penalty) are vanilla rules kept by the sims; no Forever-specific confirmation found.
Base spell/melee crit (2.3% / 1.7%) and class base attributes/health come from hand-kept tables, not Forever game files.
Flame Shock rank 6 trainer vs book: sources disagree.
No 1% spell-miss floor: wowsims rule, evidence not cited in the commit.
Mana Tide row duration 13 s vs tooltip 12 s; 4 ticks assumed.
